title: Rav Ada bar Shimi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Chullin 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.63a.11) he raised an objection to Mar bar Rav Idai; Hyman gives the [Yalkut, Zechariah, remez 578](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.578.8), reading as Rav Idi bar Shimi.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rav Ada bar Shimi and Mar bar Rav Idai. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=224&lang=en) gives the addressee as Mar bar Idai. The linked Yalkut has Rav Idi bar Shimi and Mar bar Rav Idi.
